title: Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out
caption: Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out (V)
game_text: If opponent just drew a starship or vehicle for destiny, deploy on table and stack that card here. Opponent may place a card (your choice) from your Lost Pile into your hand to place this Effect (and stacked cards) into owners’ Used Pile.
lore: “Listen, friend, we didn’t mean to land in that puddle, and if we could get our ship out, we would, but we can’t so why don’t you just...”
